data_fields.name: race_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: Human 0, Elf 1, Half-elf 1, Dwarf 2, Halfling 3, Gnome 4, Half-orc 5

data_fields.name: family_rows
data_fields.donor_constant: about 100 rows in bg2ee/pdolls.2da, each with 4 tier models

best_idea: Derive a body family key by adding bit-packed race, class and sex offsets to a base, keep the stored key once chargen ends, and pick the model from a per-family table by armour tier; return an explicit error for a missing family instead of a guessed name.
decision_why: The shared humanoid rig needs one family key and one lookup by armour tier, which this gives; but the donor uses separate model sets per family rather than one rig, its class column is misnamed on the BG2/EE path, and its miss is silent, so Frankendom keeps the key and the tier table as data with an explicit error and a PREFIX-only class term.
acceptance: A female human fighter at armour tier 2 resolves to CHFF2INV through the family key 0x6110, and a server test asserts that an unknown family key returns an explicit error rather than a guessed model name.
